name: Horns Dive
idea: From Horns, pass to one elbow, and the other big dives to the basket for a high-low pass.
why: When the ball goes to one elbow, the other big's defender turns to watch it and drifts toward the ball. That leaves the space behind them empty. A quick dive to the hoop gets there first, and the pass from high to low is a short, easy one.
tryit: Elbow passer: catch, turn and face the hoop right away. Diving big: the moment your defender looks at the ball, sprint to the front of the rim with your hands up.

frames.say: This is *Horns*: {4} and {5} at the elbows, {2} and {3} in the corners.
{1} passes to {4} at the left elbow.
{4} turns to face the hoop. {X5} steps toward the ball to help, and stops watching {5}.
*Dive:* {5} runs behind {X5}, straight to the front of the basket.
Layup! When the ball goes to one elbow, the other big dives.
